title: Correct electromotive force
description: Essential: Student must correctly determine the source EMF as 6V from the given data points.

title: Correct internal resistance
description: Essential: Student must correctly determine the internal resistance as 1Ω from the given data points.

title: Final voltmeter reading
description: Essential: Student must calculate and state the final voltmeter reading as 3V when R₃=1Ω.

title: Closed-circuit Ohm's law application
description: Important: Student must apply Ohm's law for a complete circuit (ε = I(R+r)) to relate EMF, current, and resistances.

title: Simultaneous equations setup
description: Important: Student must set up two correct equations using the given (R₁,U₁) and (R₂,U₂) data points.

title: Voltmeter voltage relationship
description: Important: Student must recognize that voltmeter reading U = I·R (voltage across external resistance).

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Student maintains consistent units (Ω, V) throughout calculations without conversion errors.

title: Sign error in voltage drop
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly writes ε = U + Ir instead of ε = U + Ir for terminal voltage, leading to wrong internal resistance.

title: Algebraic manipulation error
description: Pitfall: Student makes algebraic mistakes when solving simultaneous equations for ε and r.
